bodyDescription: Our Dental sticks with chicken have been specially developed to maintain your four-legged friend's healthy teeth. These dog snacks have a cleansing effect and ensure good condition of the gums. Moreover, they are also delicious in taste and your dog will chew on them for a long time, while taking care of his teeth in the meantime.
